CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_EmailType_CRM
AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_EmailType
AS(
    SELECT
     BCC.[VALUE] AS EmailTypeId
    ,BCC.DESCRIPTION  AS EmailTypeTypeName
    ,BCC.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BCC.CATEGORYID AS CategoryId
    ,'CRM' AS SourceSystemCode
    ,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES_DELTA BCCD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES BCC ON BCCD.CATEGORYID = BCC.CATEGORYID AND BCCD.BANK_ID = BCC.BANK_ID AND BCC.ISLATEST = 1 AND CATEGORYTYPE = 'EMAIL_TYPE'
 WHERE BCC.CATEGORYID IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_EmailType FROM TEMP_BNKM_EmailType;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_EmailType_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
EmailTypeId
,EmailTypeTypeName
,FinancialInstitutionId 
,CategoryId 
)) HASHROW, EmailTypeId,FinancialInstitutionId, RECORD_STATUS ,CATEGORYID
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_EmailType WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_EmailType_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
EmailTypeId
,EmailTypeTypeName
,FinancialInstitutionId 
,CategoryId 
)) HASHROW, EmailTypeId, FinancialInstitutionId ,CATEGORYID
FROM BNKM.EmailType --WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'CRM'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_EmailType_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.EmailTypeId,TGT.EmailTypeId) AS EmailTypeId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.CATEGORYID,TGT.CATEGORYID) AS CATEGORYID
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_EmailType_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_EmailType_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.EmailTypeId = TGT.EmailTypeId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.CATEGORYID = TGT.CATEGORYID
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_EmailType_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_EmailType_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT 
SET
 EmailTypeId  = SRC.EmailTypeId 
,EmailTypeTypeName  = SRC.EmailTypeTypeName 
,CategoryId  = SRC.CategoryId 
FROM BNKM.EmailType TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_EmailType_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.EmailTypeId = TGT.EmailTypeId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.CATEGORYID = TGT.CATEGORYID AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_EmailType SRC ON SRC.EmailTypeId = TGT.EmailTypeId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND SRC.CATEGORYID = TGT.CATEGORYID ;
 

----INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.EmailType
([EmailTypeId]
,[EmailTypeTypeName]
,[EmailTypeDescription]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[CategoryId]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm] )

SELECT
     EmailTypeId AS EmailTypeId
    ,EmailTypeTypeName AS EmailTypeTypeName
    ,NULL AS EmailTypeDescription
    ,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,CategoryId AS CategoryId
    ,SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_EmailType
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_EmailType;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_EmailType_DELTA;

END
